shared_rules: DuckOS stores complete upstream source snapshots as ordinary tracked directories under projects/<id>; a normal clone contains all four source trees without submodule initialization.
Import exact source commits with Git fetch plus git read-tree --prefix; never vendor a floating branch head.
The upstream commit SHA and root tree SHA are recorded in federation/vendor-sources.v1.json and checked against the committed directory tree.
Keep every upstream LICENSE, NOTICE, contributor attribution and nested third-party notice in its original relative path.
Do not flatten or merge product source directories; keep project-local include, src, tests, docs, schemas, tools and build files intact.
Reconcile root-level build, CI and package metadata centrally; nested upstream .github workflows are retained as provenance but are not active root workflows.
Upstream repositories remain independent development and release sources; sync changes as reviewed, reproducible source-tree imports.
Do not automatically execute imported programs, plugins, drivers, installers, scripts or manifests during normal OS boot.
Reaper programs and extensions remain user-space unless a separate freestanding ABI, kernel gate and target test explicitly authorize a native system component.
Pytyliki and OPlague hardware evidence remains read-only; VentuSample remains offline by default.
An imported source tree is not proof of runtime integration, native DuckOS execution, kernel privilege, device support or release qualification.
